body:
🟠🐛 **Fix · bug: Arrow-left from the unchecked-in-list "Custom" chip lands on the wrong preset**

When the Size value is custom (not a preset), `enabled` excludes the custom chip, so `current` is -1. Pressing → goes to index 0 (correct), but pressing ← computes `(-1 - 1 + n) % n = n - 2`, which is the second-to-last preset instead of the last one. Treat `current === -1` specially: for delta < 0 pick `enabled.length - 1`, for delta > 0 pick 0.

🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: Doc comment sits on the wrong function**

The block "Header + settings (or the blocked card), and the focus contract…" is placed above `useSettingsFocus`, but the first half describes `CameraSettingsContent`, which has no comment. Split the comment between the two.

🟡📜 **Consider · rules: Hardcoded ON/OFF status text bypasses i18n**

Everything else on this tile goes through `useTranslations`, but "ON"/"OFF" are literals, so the Spanish locale shows English. Move them into the `cameraSettings` messages (unless the existing plain tile deliberately keeps them as literals, in which case ignore).

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Unmount drops a pending throttled camera change**

The effect cleanup clears `timer.current` without flushing. If the user changes a setting and the drawer or popover closes within PERSIST_EVERY_MS (60 ms), the last change is applied on screen but never sent to main, so it is lost. Flush `latest.current` through `updateSettings` on cleanup when a timer is pending, and do the same for a patch still held in `early`.

🟠🐛 **Fix · bug: Switching P then V keeps the ratio but not a box that matches it**

`locked` is null while the intent is `capture`, so the box can be freely drawn or resized after pressing P. The chosen ratio stays in `ratio` state. Pressing V sets `recording` back to true, and the frame is not passed through `fitRatio`. The ratio chip then shows e.g. 16:9 as pressed, and Start (line 323) and Enter send `ratio` with a rect that is not 16:9. The remembered area stores that ratio, so the next open refits the box and it jumps. Refit the frame when `recording` turns true, for example in an effect keyed on `recording`. Alternatively, reset `ratio` to `free` when leaving record.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Pending start can stay armed after the pick**

`pendingStartId` is only cleared when the selected source matches and nothing is recording. If the settings write fails or the selection ends up on a different source, the id stays set. A later change to that source (for example choosing it again from the tray) would then start a recording unexpectedly. Consider clearing it on picker re-open or after a timeout.

🟡🧪 **Consider · tests: Test name promises the panel grows, but only containment is asserted**

The test is named "…opens the inline drawer, growing the panel" but only checks that the drawer is a descendant of the root element. Either rename it to what it checks, or assert the growth (for example, that the ResizeObserver-driven resize is requested after opening).

**Verdict: wrong (false positive).** `current` is never -1 here: the Custom chip is `disabled: preset !== null` (camera-settings-fields.tsx:162), so it is disabled only while the size is a preset. When the size is custom, Custom is both checked and enabled, `current` is 3, and ← lands on Large. I wrote the suggested branch, and a test for it passes both with and without the change, so I reverted the code. I kept the test as a regression pin in a2e1c382. Reviewer note: `enabled` is derived from `disabled`, which depends on the value, so check how that flag is computed before assuming the checked option is filtered out.
**Verdict: correct.** Fixed in 4b37e3fe: `useSettingsFocus` keeps only the focus-contract half, and `CameraSettingsContent` gets its own comment.

**Verdict: correct, and the gap is wider than reported.** No caller passes `onText`/`offText` to `StatusToggleRow`, so the plain Mic and Audio tiles also showed the `StatusToggle` defaults ("ON"/"OFF") in Spanish. Fixed in 63c5ad23: new `record.statusOn`/`statusOff` keys (en ON/OFF, es SÍ/NO), passed by `RecordingToggles` and used by the split camera tile.

**Verdict: correct for the timer, wrong for the early patch.** Fixed in c8191ad8: on unmount, a pending throttled change is sent instead of dropped, with a test that fails without the fix. I did not flush `early`. That patch exists only because the saved value has not loaded yet. Writing it then would merge it over the defaults and wipe the saved device and shape, which is the bug the `early` path was added to prevent. A change made in the first moments after mount and before the first read is still lost on unmount, which is the safer failure.

**Verdict: correct.** Fixed in 75e653ab: when `recording` turns true, the frame is refit to the current ratio, so the rect and the ratio that Start sends agree. The existing P-then-V test now asserts the box is 16:9 right after V, and it fails without the fix.

**Verdict: correct.** Fixed in fc408412: reopening the source picker clears an armed start-on-pick, so a pick whose selection never landed cannot start a take later. The new page test fails without the fix. It also exposed that the test helper's `rerender` reused the same element, which React skips; the helper now builds a fresh one.

**Verdict: correct.** Renamed in 725642f7 to what the test asserts: the drawer opens inside the root the ResizeObserver measures. Asserting the actual growth needs the Electron window resize, which jsdom does not have.
